board_note: Scores are model projections until final. Lines are the nflverse consensus; open is the first line the model saw. Times in your local zone.
method_html:
Team strength

Opponent-adjusted EPA per play on offense and defense (nflverse play-by-play), fit by weighted ridge regression each week. Recent games count more (0.93× per week of age), garbage time is excluded (win probability outside 5–95%), and ratings are shrunk toward 50% of last season's values so early weeks stay stable. Net EPA/play × 62 plays converts to points.

Elo

A 538-style Elo from game results since 2009 (K=20, margin-of-victory multiplier, ⅓ regression each off-season), 25 Elo points per point of spread.

Quarterbacks

Each starter's EPA per dropback (this season, last season at 70%, two seasons ago at 40%), shrunk toward replacement level (250 dropbacks of prior). The starter listed in the nflverse schedule is compared with the QB play the team's ratings were built on; the difference × 35 dropbacks moves the line (capped at ±9). Backup starts are the biggest single adjustment in the model.

Projection

Margin = 60% EPA + 40% Elo + QB adjustment + 1.6 points home field (none at neutral sites) + a small rest term (0.05 pts/day, capped; post-2011 rest effects are near zero). Cover probability uses a margin distribution reweighted to real NFL final margins since 2005, so key numbers like 3 and 7 carry their true weight and pushes are priced.

Picks, confidence and tuning

Edge = projected margin vs the line. Tiers: lean 1.5+, play 3+, strong 4.5+. Confidence (0–100) weighs whether EPA and Elo each cover on their own, edge, line movement, ATS trends, and data quality (games played, known starting QBs). After each week the EPA/Elo weights and home field are refit to this season's results and moved part of the way there.

Data: nflverse (CC BY 4.0) schedules, lines and play-by-play. For entertainment only.
subtitle: Opponent-adjusted EPA, QB-adjusted, Elo-blended NFL spreads
